```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

# ---- Load dataset... kagle does not have a url option
input_file <- "C:/Users/cpeng/Downloads/archive/accident_details_compiled.csv"
raw_data <- read_csv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Standardise column names 
names(raw_data) <- c("source", "date", "time", "location", "operator", "flight_no",
                     "route", "ac_type", "registration", "cn_ln", "aboard",
                     "fatalities", "ground", "summary")

#Keyword patterns 
rx <- function(x) regex(paste(x, collapse = "|"), ignore_case = TRUE)

## filter out military
military_op <- rx(c("^\\s*mil+i?tary", "/\\s*military", "air ?force", "\\barmy\\b",
                    "\\bnavy\\b", "naval", "marine corps", "\\bUSAF\\b", "\\bRAF\\b",
                    "\\bIAF\\b", "national guard", "luftwaffe", "luftstreitkr",
                    "defen[sc]e", "ministry of", "fuerza\\s+a", "ej[eé]rcito",
                    "armada", "aeronautica militare?", "\\bforce\\b", "soviet air"))
military_sum <- rx(c("military (flight|aircraft|transport|plane)",
                     "air force (plane|aircraft|transport)"))

## get (OUt) the chopptas
helicopter_ac <- rx(c("helicopter", "rotor", "rotocraft", "copter", "ecureuil",
                      "\\bMi-?\\d", "\\bMil\\b", "sikors", "\\bAS[- ]?3\\d\\d",
                      "\\bSA ?3\\d\\d", "\\bBell\\b", "robinson", "agusta",
                      "\\bEC[- ]?\\d{3}", "\\bBO[- ]?105", "\\bS-?(58|61|64|70|76|92)\\b",
                      "puma", "chinook", "vertol", "alouette", "frelon",
                      "\\bUH-?\\d", "\\bCH-?\\d", "\\bAW ?\\d{3}", "hughes", "\\bMD ?500"))

## for the 2 that still exist
non_airplane_ac <- rx(c("balloon", "blimp", "airship", "glider", "zeppelin"))

## im sorry wilson
cargo_op  <- rx(c("cargo", "freight", "parcel", "courier", "\\bmail\\b", "\\bFedEx\\b",
                  "\\bUPS\\b", "\\bDHL\\b", "aeropostale", "air ?lift"))
cargo_sum <- rx(c("cargo (plane|flight|aircraft)", "freighter", "all[- ]cargo",
                  "carrying cargo", "mail (plane|flight)"))

## UN Edge case urthg
govt_op <- rx(c("government", "presidential", "police", "united nations", "\\bUN\\b",
                "red cross", "border (guard|patrol)", "customs", "emergency (ministry|situations)",
                "emercom", "\\bFAA\\b", "\\bNASA\\b", "forest service", "state aviation",
                "royal flight"))

## drones maybe
surveillance_kw <- rx(c("surveillance (flight|mission|aircraft|plane)", "reconnaissance",
                        "aerial survey", "survey flight", "aerial photograph", "\\bspy\\b",
                        "intelligence", "news (helicopter|plane|aircraft)"))

private_op <- rx(c("(^|-\\s*)private", "charter", "taxi", "air ambulance",
                   "flying (club|service)", "illegal flight"))
illegal_sum <- rx(c("illegal", "unauthori[sz]ed", "unlicensed", "unregistered", "smuggl",
                    "drug (smuggl|traffick|flight|run)", "narcotic", "contraband",
                    "clandestine", "stolen|steal")) ## rip skyking

non_revenue_kw <- rx(c("test flight", "training flight", "ferry flight", "positioning flight",
                       "delivery flight", "demonstration flight", "air show", "flight test",
                       "maintenance flight", "demonstration", "\\btest\\b"))

# Parse passengers > 0
flagged <- raw_data %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(operator, route, ac_type, summary), ~ replace_na(as.character(.x), "")),
    aboard_total = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_extract(aboard, "^\\s*\\d+"))),
    passengers   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_match(aboard, "passengers:\\s*(\\d+)")[, 2])),
    crew         = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_match(aboard, "crew:\\s*(\\d+)")[, 2])),
    date_parsed  = mdy(date),
    year         = year(date_parsed)
  ) %>%
  #Restrict to 2002-01-01 through 2023-12-31
  filter(!is.na(date_parsed),
         date_parsed >= as.Date("2002-01-01"),
         date_parsed <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>%
  # First matching rule wins
  mutate(excluded_because = case_when(
    str_detect(operator, military_op) | str_detect(summary, military_sum) ~ "Military aviation",
    str_detect(ac_type, helicopter_ac) | str_detect(summary, regex("helicopter", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Helicopter",
    str_detect(ac_type, non_airplane_ac)                                   ~ "Balloon / airship / glider",
    str_detect(operator, cargo_op) | str_detect(summary, cargo_sum)        ~ "Cargo flight",
    passengers == 0 |
      (is.na(passengers) & !is.na(aboard_total) & !is.na(crew) & aboard_total == crew) ~ "No passengers",
    str_detect(operator, govt_op)                                          ~ "Government flight",
    str_detect(paste(operator, route, summary), surveillance_kw)           ~ "Surveillance mission",
    str_detect(operator, private_op) | str_detect(summary, illegal_sum)    ~ "Private / charter / illegal",
    str_detect(route, non_revenue_kw) | str_detect(summary, non_revenue_kw) ~ "Test / ferry / training",
    operator %in% c("", "?", "-")                                          ~ "Unknown operator",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

#table
commercial_pax <- flagged %>% filter(is.na(excluded_because)) %>% select(-excluded_because)
all_excluded   <- flagged %>% filter(!is.na(excluded_because))

# Summary
cat("Rows in raw file:                      ", nrow(raw_data), "\n")
cat("Rows in date range (before exclusions):", nrow(flagged), "\n")
cat("Rows after exclusions:                 ", nrow(commercial_pax), "\n\n")
all_excluded %>% count(excluded_because, sort = TRUE) %>% print()



# sum
curated_data <- commercial_pax %>%
  distinct(date, operator, registration, location, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Rows in curated_data:", nrow(curated_data), "\n")
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Tally top 15 airlines/carriers and visualize
curated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(operator), operator != "") %>%
  mutate(operator = str_to_title(trimws(operator))) %>%
  count(operator, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(operator, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkslateblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Airlines/Carriers by Accident Count",
    subtitle = "Commercial Passenger Fixed-Wing Aircraft (2002–2023)",
    x = "Airline / Carrier",
    y = "Number of Accidents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

#Load & clean the airline -> country lookup
norm_name <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_replace_all("&", " and ") %>%
    str_replace_all("[^[:alnum:] ]", " ") %>%
    str_squish()
}

airline_lookup <- fromJSON("C:/Users/cpeng/Desktop/airlines_by_country.json") %>% ## copy path did not work apparently slashes were backwards?
  as_tibble() %>%
  # drop the ints from .json because webscrapper scrapped a little too much oops
  filter(!str_detect(Airline_URL, "/photos/"),
         !str_detect(Airline, "^[0-9,]+$")) %>%
  mutate(key = norm_name(Airline)) %>%
  # edge case testing
  group_by(key) %>%
  summarise(Country = first(Country),
            ambiguous = n_distinct(Country) > 1,
            .groups = "drop")

# Join crashes to country
crashes_country <- curated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(operator), operator != "") %>%
  mutate(key = norm_name(operator)) %>%
  left_join(airline_lookup, by = "key")

#Peekaboo at crash matching
cat("Matched:", sum(!is.na(crashes_country$Country)), "of", nrow(crashes_country), "\n")

crashes_country %>%
  filter(is.na(Country)) %>%
  count(operator, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(30)          

#Crashes by country
country_counts <- crashes_country %>%
  filter(!is.na(Country)) %>%
  count(Country, sort = TRUE)

country_counts

country_counts %>%
  slice_max(n, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Country, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkslateblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 15 Countries by Accident Count",
       subtitle = "Commercial Passenger Fixed-Wing Aircraft (2002–2024)",
       x = "Country", y = "Number of Accidents") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}

library(pscl)      
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)


airline_year_panel <- curated_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(operator), operator != "") %>%
  mutate(operator = str_to_title(trimws(operator))) %>%
  # Count actual accidents per airline per year
  count(operator, year, name = "n_accidents") %>%
  # Expand grid to include all combinations of operators and years (2002-2023)
  complete(
    operator, 
    year = 2002:2023, 
    fill = list(n_accidents = 0)
  )

# Preview the panel showing zeros
head(airline_year_panel, 10)

# Formula structure: count_variables ~ predictors | zero_inflation_predictors
zip_model <- zeroinfl(
  n_accidents ~ year | year, 
  data = airline_year_panel,
  dist = "poisson" # Use "negbin" if your data exhibits high overdispersion
)

# View model summary
summary(zip_model)


standard_poisson <- glm(n_accidents ~ year, data = airline_year_panel, family = poisson)

vuong(zip_model, standard_poisson)
```

```{r}
airline_year_panel <- airline_year_panel %>%
  mutate(predicted_accidents = predict(zip_model, type = "response"))

ggplot(airline_year_panel, aes(x = year, y = n_accidents)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.2, height = 0.1, color = "darkslateblue") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Observed vs. Model-Predicted Accident Trends (2002–2023)",
    subtitle = "Zero-Inflated Poisson Regression Fit",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Accidents per Airline"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
